name: TC Newsletter Coupons
author: trianglecode

sections.description:
TC Newsletter Coupons is a lightweight and easy to setup WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that boosts your store’s conversion rate by automatically generating personalized discount coupons for new subscribers.

Stop Paying for Expensive Automations
Most newsletter platforms charge high monthly fees to access “Automation” or “Customer Journeys.” TC Newsletter Coupons handles the logic on your server. By generating the coupon within WordPress the moment a subscriber is detected, you can often stick to the “Free” tiers of your newsletter provider while still delivering premium automated rewards.

If you’ve tried other marketing automation tools, you know they can be overwhelming to configure. This plugin is designed to be fast, intuitive, and easy to set up, while still covering 99% of your lead-capture needs. Get all the essential features without the unnecessary complexity, and save time on setup so you can focus on growing your website.

What the plugin offers:

-Automated Coupon Generation
Automatically create unique WooCommerce coupons whenever a new user joins your mailing list. This instant gratification encourages immediate purchases and improves the customer’s first impression of your brand with zero manual work required.

-Mailchimp Integration
Seamlessly connect your store with Mailchimp to track new registrations. The plugin listens for new subscribers and triggers the coupon creation process instantly, ensuring your marketing funnel remains fluid and high-converting across all devices.

-Conversion Optimization
Turn casual browsers into loyal customers by offering timely rewards. By automating the “discount-for-signup” workflow, you increase your click-through rates from email campaigns and give search engines and users a clearer reason to engage with your store.

-Misc Tools
Enhance your marketing strategy by setting custom expiration dates and usage limits for auto-generated coupons. This allows you to create a sense of urgency for new leads, improving your store’s performance and overall user experience without slowing down your site.
Auto-assign coupons to specific email addresses to prevent discount abuse.

WPML compatible

Configuration

The configuration is very straight forward. The plugin consists of the following options :

  • MailChimp Key
    Enables MailChimp integration with a random numeric string to verify that the request is from MailChimp
  • Coupon Code
    An existing coupon code to use as a template for its settings (discount type, amount, usage limits etc.)
  • Coupon Prefix
    A short text string to the beginning of every coupon code
  • Coupon Age
    The number of days after which the generated coupon will expire
  • Coupon Lock
    Limit the coupon to the same email that was registered for the newsletter
  • Email Subject
    The Email Subject Line
  • From Email Address
    The email address that will appear in the “From” field
  • From Display Name
    The name that will appear in the “From” field
  • Email Message
    The message content for your email
  • Clear Plugin Data
    Deletes all plugin settings and stored data upon uninstall.
sections.installation:
Download the latest version and extract it into the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
After activation, open the Triangle Code admin menu and enable the features you want.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, it is 100% free and all settings are accessible. No paid version is available.
